title: Bose–Einstein Condensation in Quantum Boltzmann Dynamics
exact_target: Show that an initially noncondensed Bose gas can form a zero-energy condensate in finite time, or at least concentrate positive mass there.

status_qualification: Both the finite-time atom and the weaker concentration alternative are retained. The source writes the weaker quantity as lim_(epsilon->0) sup_(0<=t<=t_0) F_t([0,epsilon]); the catalogue limsup notation should be read with this temporal supremum. The source's existence question is not a claim of condensation from every initial datum, and its absolutely continuous initial-data condition cannot be dropped.
